meta.title: Vocabulary review
meta.description: Turns an uploaded worksheet image into a one-word-at-a-time review loop. The model extracts only the underlined English words and calls vocab_import; the plugin keeps the clean list, never the image. The plugin owns ledger.json and settings.json, wrong-word error counts and re-asks, the 30m→3h→12h→2d→7d→30d spaced-repetition ladder, the compact QUEUE/DUE lines injected each turn, the configurable daily new/review/total/minutes quotas with the 今日已达上限 stop state, the once-per-day due reminder (sidebar badge, panel banner, optional browser notification), a conversation selector that routes every Q/A prompt to the selected non-archived session and persists it in settings.json, and a strong-pause Stop (agent.cancel + jobs/terminals/subagents cleanup, silent, no transcript message). Adds a left-sidebar Vocabulary review panel with due count, recent error words, queue, counters, Start/Stop/Pause, editable limits saved without a restart, and an optional QQ channel: when dsh-qq-bot has bound a session, the plugin pushes each question to that QQ chat through the bot's send_qq_message and grades the answers typed there, so the same ledger and schedule can be reviewed on QQ. Review runs in the selected chat session. Turn the plugin off to stop all injection, reminders and API routes; ledger.json and settings.json stay on disk.
